description: Everything the app's window may ask the app to do. Nothing else: no files, no shell, no network from the window. The worker (../worker) does the network: outbound to pool.visualia.space and to Ollama on 127.0.0.1:11434 only. open-get-ollama opens one fixed page, https://ollama.com/download, in the browser. set-autostart adds or removes the app's own login item (a LaunchAgent that starts it with --join): on while a key is saved.
